compounds.source: Cardinals 1-12 and the combining stems দু, ছ, ন: Wiktionary, Appendix:Bengali numerals, oldid=95460450 (দুবার, ছবার, নবার). The hour classifier -টা and its forms: H.-R. Thompson, Bengali (2012), 'ta is added to numbers for time references. tinta baje three oclock', 'duto two, tinte three, carte four', 'aj sokale noytay'.
একদিন 'one day': Wiktionary, Appendix:Bengali numerals writes এক-compounds as one word (একবার, একগুণ).
H.-R. Thompson, Bengali (LOALL 18, John Benjamins 2012), Appendix II: 'one and a half der', 'two and a half arai'; the hour classifier as above.
